Raider Helag is a githyanki raider in Crèche Y’llek in Act One.

Involvement

Act One

She is a member of a squad sent by  Kith’rak Therezzyn to search for the ‘weapon’ wanted by  Inquisitor W’wargaz, soon after the party approach the Captain’s Quarters.

Helag cannot be spoken with. As soon as the cutscene ends, she runs down the corridor towards the Trade Post and disappears.
